questions.text: Which ATS systems do you use?
Does your ATS give an AI or percentage match score, and do you use it?
Does your ATS reject applicants automatically based on resume content (formatting, keywords, skills)?
If yes, roughly what share of applicants does it reject?
If not, where have you heard that ATS systems reject resumes automatically?
Does applying early improve a candidate's chances?
How do you handle postings with a very high number of applicants?
Beyond qualifications and location, what else decides who moves forward? Any advice for candidates?
